maana: Mtu unayemfurahia na kuwa na uhusiano mzuri naye
mfano: Rafiki yangu anaitwa Juma (My friend is called Juma)
Tulikuwa rafiki wa dhati (We were close friends)

maana: Mtu anayefundisha watu shuleni, chuo kikuu, au mahali pengine
mfano: Mwalimu wetu anafundisha Kiswahili (Our teacher teaches Swahili)
Walimu walikutana kwa mkutano (The teachers met for a conference)

maana: Binadamu mdogo asiyeifikia umri wa utu uzima
mfano: Mtoto analala (The child is sleeping)
Watoto wanacheza uwanjani (Children are playing in the field)

maana: Mtu anayesoma shuleni, chuo kikuu, au mahali pengine pa elimu
mfano: Mwanafunzi anaandika mtihani (The student is writing an exam)
Wanafunzi wanasoma maktabani (Students are studying in the library)

maana: Mtu asiye wa eneo hilo; mtu anayetembelea nyumba ya mtu mwingine
mfano: Mgeni amefika nyumbani (A guest has arrived at home)
Tunawakaribisha wageni (We welcome visitors)
matumizi: Hutumika kwa mtu asiye wa mahali hapo

maana: Makaratasi yaliyoandikwa au kuchapishwa na kuunganishwa pamoja kwa ajili ya kusoma
mfano: Ninasoma kitabu cha Kiswahili (I am reading a Swahili book)
Vitabu viko mezani (The books are on the table)

maana: Chuma chenye makali kinachotumika kukata vitu
mfano: Anakata nyama kwa kisu (He is cutting meat with a knife)
Visu vikali vinahitajika jikoni (Sharp knives are needed in the kitchen)

maana: Chombo kidogo cha kunywea chai, kahawa, au maji
mfano: Nakunywa chai kwenye kikombe (I am drinking tea in a cup)
Vikombe vimeoshwa (The cups are washed)

maana: Samani ya kukalia yenye mgongo na mikono au bila mikono
mfano: Keti kwenye kiti (Sit on the chair)
Viti vimepangwa vizuri (The chairs are arranged well)

maana: Kitu kinacholiwa ili kuupa mwili nguvu na kukua
mfano: Chakula kitamu kimepikwa (Delicious food has been cooked)
Vyakula vya asili ni bora (Traditional foods are better)

maana: Jengo la kuishi au kukaa
mfano: Nyumba yangu iko karibu na shule (My house is near the school)
Nyumba mpya inajengwa (A new house is being built)

maana: Chombo cha usafiri chenye magurudumu kinachoendeshwa na injini
mfano: Gari jipya linauzwa (A new car is for sale)
Magari yanasubiri kwenye taa za barabarani (Cars are waiting at traffic lights)

maana: Mahali pa kujifunzia elimu
mfano: Watoto wanaenda shule (Children are going to school)
Shule yetu ina wanafunzi wengi (Our school has many students)

maana: Eneo kubwa lenye nyumba nyingi na shughuli nyingi za kiuchumi
mfano: Nairobi ni mji mkubwa (Nairobi is a big city)
Anaishi mjini (He lives in the city)

maana: Umajimaji usio na rangi unaotumiwa kunywa, kuoga na kupikia
mfano: Maji ya kunywa yanatosha (Drinking water is enough)
Anga maji moto kwa chai (Boil hot water for tea)

maana: Joto kali pamoja na mwale unaotokana na kuchoma kitu
mfano: Moto unawaka jikoni (Fire is burning in the kitchen)
Kaa mbali na moto (Stay away from fire)

maana: Sehemu ya mmea yenye ranga nzuri na harufu nzuri
mfano: Alinipa ua zuri (She gave me a beautiful flower)
Maua yamechanika bustanini (Flowers have bloomed in the garden)

maana: Mnyama wa kufugwa anayeweza kulinda nyumba
mfano: Mbwa anabweka (The dog is barking)
Mbwa mwitu wana hatari (Wild dogs are dangerous)

maana: Mnyama mdogo wa kufugwa anayependa kula panya
mfano: Paka anawinda panya (The cat is hunting a rat)
Paka wetu ana watoto watatu (Our cat has three kittens)

maana: Mnyama mwenye mabawa na manyoya anayeweza kuruka
mfano: Ndege wanaimba asubuhi (Birds are singing in the morning)
Ndege akaruka angani (The bird flew in the sky)

maana: Mnyama anayeishi ndani ya maji anayeweza kuliwa
mfano: Samaki wanaogelea mtoni (Fish are swimming in the river)
Tulikula samaki waliokaanga (We ate fried fish)

maana: Kipindi cha muda cha siku 365 au 366
mfano: Mwaka mpya umefika (New year has arrived)
Alisoma kwa miaka minne (He studied for four years)

maana: Kipindi cha muda cha masaa 24 kuanzia jua linapochomoza hadi linapochomoza tena
mfano: Siku njema (Good day)
Kesho ni siku nyingine (Tomorrow is another day)

maana: Kipindi cha giza wakati jua linapozama hadi linapochomoza tena
mfano: Usiku mwema (Good night)
Alifika usiku wa manane (He arrived late at night)

maana: Wakati wa mapema baada ya jua kuchomoza
mfano: Asubuhi njema (Good morning)
Huanza kazi asubuhi (He starts work in the morning)

maana: Wakati wa mwisho wa mchana kabla ya jua kuzama
mfano: Jioni njema (Good evening)
Tutakutana jioni (We'll meet in the evening)
matumizi: Hutumika kwa wakati wa mwisho wa mchana

maana: Mahali pa kuishi au kukaa
mfano: Niko nyumbani (I am at home)
Karibu nyumbani (Welcome home)

maana: Mahali pa kujifunzia elimu
mfano: Ninaenda shuleni (I am going to school)
Walimu wapo shuleni (Teachers are at school)

maana: Mahali pa kuabudia
mfano: Wanaenda kanisani Jumapili (They go to church on Sunday)
Kuna mkutano kanisani (There is a meeting at church)

maana: Mahali pa kuabudia Waislamu
mfano: Wanaenda msikitini Ijumaa (They go to the mosque on Friday)
Aliomba msikitini (He prayed at the mosque)
matumizi: Hutumika kwa mahali pa ibada ya Kiislamu

maana: Mahali pa kununulia na kuuzia bidhaa
mfano: Mama anaenda sokoni (Mother is going to the market)
Tulikutana sokoni (We met at the market)

maana: Mahali pa kupata matibabu
mfano: Mgonjwa yuko hospitalini (The patient is in the hospital)
Ninaenda hospitalini kumwona daktari (I'm going to the hospital to see the doctor)
